svg.title: Average S&P 500 change by month, 1928–2026
svg.desc: Animated bar chart of the S&P 500's average monthly change. January +1.18%, February −0.11%, March +0.47%, April +1.39%, May +0.05%, June +0.81%, July +1.69%, August +0.67%, September −1.08%, October +0.53%, November +1.01%, December +1.26%. The November to April window is highlighted as the best six months.

g.text: NOV → APR · THE BEST SIX MONTHS
Sum of the six monthly averages in each window.
Historical averages, not a forecast. Past seasonality does not guarantee future results.
